releaseNotes: Mark as done and Undo now preserve open weeks, expanded cards, keyboard focus and page position in Assignments and Overview.
Attendance adds a collapsed-by-default subject summary with Present, Pending, Late and Absent counts across all saved attendance.
Subject totals use the saved timetable mapping, keep unassigned periods visible, and treat blank statuses as pending rather than absent.
No extra LMS requests. Existing credentials, settings, student history, private completion status and saved resources are preserved.
